hotspot_pct_threshold.description: Share of e2e wall-clock (percent) at or above which a kernel in profile/e2e.baseline.json `ranking` is a hotspot and must be accounted for before the optimize phase may be left.

max_gate_attempts.description: Failed gates to refine through before escalating the unmet criteria as a recorded blocker.

phases.description: Keyed by phase name: detect, inventory, scaffold, migrate, integrate, profile-e2e, optimize, done, report.

status.description: `exited` is written ONLY by `evidence.sh gate <phase>` when every criterion is met (or waived). Hand-editing it to 'exited' is what check E15 exists to catch.

attempts.description: Incremented on every gate evaluation. A phase that passed on attempt 3 is a phase that was refined twice — that history is part of the audit.

unmet.description: Criteria that failed on the last evaluation, verbatim from the gate.

waivers.description: A criterion deliberately not met. A waiver is a legitimate exit — an unrecorded skip is not.

criterion.description: The criterion id being waived, e.g. optimize.hotspots_accounted.

reason.description: Why it cannot be met. 'It was hard' is not a reason; 'unitrace segfaults on this driver, blocker recorded' is.

blast_radius.description: What is unknown or unproven as a result — the cost the reader inherits.

evidence.description: Run id(s) of the failed attempt, where one exists. A tool that crashed still leaves a record.

review.description: Result of the sycl-review pass at this boundary. The review runs AFTER the mechanical gate and may not override its verdict.

reviewer.description: Fresh-context subagent id or 'inline' when the review ran in the main conversation.

scope.description: The frozen work-item denominator. Enforced by check E17.

changes.description: Every later change to the denominator. Removing a work item is allowed; removing it silently is not.

reason.description: Why the denominator moved. Re-cutting the inventory at a coarser granularity is a reason that must be stated, because it changes every percentage in the report.
